findings.summary: fleet_node_name duplicates reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:431 fleet_record_node, whose body it wraps unchanged, and its try/except guard cannot fire because dispatch_launch._read_fleet_record at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:3704 already returns None for an unreadable record; reckon/crew/merge.py:216 shows the established idiom is to call the owner directly.

the new pass applies no landing_group refusal, while the owner of the same decision at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:503 holds every landing-group pointer and the group branch at line 688 releases members only on group-integration evidence, so a promoted-marked group member with no workspace on disk and a quiet foreign stream would be retired ahead of its group landing.

item_verdicts.diff: read all ten commits against d24fa090e52748cc3100cd54e60d68ad3e87fb1b; 83047227cc adds the pass, its two liveness readings and the test, 1bb7fca9cf and f77f50a4fc repair it, 41ba34fc8d adds the journal and scope cases, and the remaining five commits are the evidence fragment and the SVG; 692 insertions, nothing removed outside those paths. The SVG renders at 1400 px with all thirty text labels present, no clipped or overlapping label.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when at docs/plans/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released.html:51 asks for three promoted fixture runs in a temporary crew home, one pass, two further passes for the discarded run, a base-revision negative control and no added failure in the existing release tests; tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py covers each of those cases and the recorded arms show EXIT=0 with 58 passed at the base and 66 passed after.
item_verdicts.goal: plan section s2's deliverable at docs/plans/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released.html:50 is a promoted run whose recorded launcher host is not the fleet node and which shows no turn in progress giving up its pointer on the next pass, and whose discard is not undone; reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:567 release_pointers_of_a_previous_fleet_node does exactly that and is called from retire_promoted_pointers at line 677.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, ten commits, the scoped gate at 67 passed, both suite arms with completed true and empty failure_ids, three negative-control runs each EXIT=1, and its changed_paths line names all five delivered paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the declared write paths; the five committed paths (reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew/process_liveness.py, tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py, the evidence fragment and the figure directory) are all inside them, and reckon/crew/promotion_release.py was declared but not needed.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py:118 and :132 redden if the release pass or the turn-in-progress hold is removed (recorded at 3 failed and 2 failed on the base and reviewed heads), but no case builds a landing-group member, so the new pass's missing landing_group refusal at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:616 is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the gate recorded in the manifest runs tests/test_a_run_from_a_previous_fleet_node_is_released.py with the two existing release files and its logs end EXIT=0 with 67, 58 and 66 passed, so the done_when's five cases, the base negative control and the no-added-failure clause are each measured rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:567 and reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:545 follow the module's lazy-import, Mapping-typed, mechanism-named idiom and carry no plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:567 retires a promoted pointer whose launcher host is not the fleet record's node and whose stream shows no turn, and reckons/crew/process_liveness.py:586 makes a foreign record never consult this host's process table, which is the deliverable at docs/plans/a-claim-nobody-is-working-is-released.html:50.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:570 adds fleet_node_name, a one-line wrapper around reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:431 fleet_record_node, which is the existing owner of that reading and is called directly at reckon/crew/merge.py:216, so the addition duplicates the owner rather than extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the ten-commit diff is inside the declared write paths, and the two repair commits touch only reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew/process_liveness.py and the test file.
